pages.title: Interstellar Scoop
pages.text: Sweeps up the thin gas and dust between the stars. Only high above the world, or out in space.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 1$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.
Needs nothing but to be high: at y 200 or above in the Overworld, or anywhere in the Accretion Frontier or the End. It gathers Molecular Cloud gas, Interstellar Medium and Interstellar Dust.

$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 1 fluid inputs, 1 and 1 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Cosmic Ray Shard, Glass Bottle, Interstellar Dust, Interstellar Medium, Molecular Cloud, Satellite Image Plate.
